## Required follow-up: ROOT-A2-WALL

The author honestly reports an ordinary-input failure from its staged rescue approach: W reaches only 3.1557 mm outside the real wall; the camera near plane crosses it and the view turns blue. Root inspected the actual contact image and independently replayed all 150 input ticks. All three complete exported states match exactly, with 55 near-plane-crossing steps, no health loss/new failures and a successful retreat. The assertion that no crossing occurs correctly fails; this is not a passed contact-visibility result.

Root minimized the reproduction to **22 forward steps** from the unchanged export. At tick 24445 the centre is X54.04649674/Y−39.31140223/Z−59.5; the body centre is 4.65 cm outside the wall while part of the near plane crosses it. `node /tmp/siltwake-m2-terrain-root/wall-contact-minimal.mjs` fails deterministically. The longer retained replay is `wall-contact-repro.mjs`; it preserves the author's full-state comparison before its expected failing assertion.

Ranked hypotheses were centre-only terrain collision, later support correction losing clearance, and mismatched camera origins. The root probe confirms the first: clearance accepts radii 0/.07/.34/1 at this position although the west body footprint reaches the −13 m bench. The actual player sweep returns the same unsafe final XZ without a hit; no subsequent correction changes that XZ. Interaction and rendered diver eye origins are equal. `wall-hypotheses.json` retains these measurements. The physical wall and camera datum must remain; hiding/moving the wall or shrinking the near plane would conceal the defect.
